phase: P1 fifth increment: opt-in management-only worker, durable supervision and confirmed-stop recovery
implemented: Explicit MANAGEMENT_ONLY alternative to the unchanged default LEGACY child; entries must remain disabled. No concurrent entry/settlement worker bundle is enabled.

Dedicated immutable management configuration validates only interval, Testnet account/write acknowledgement, exit fee and rate-budget mode. Missing or malformed symbols/JEV/TV/quant fields do not block management startup.

Minimal real Testnet adapter composition constructs no strategy/model/cache/archive/projector/settlement/notification dependencies. Native protection, basic/emergency exits and frozen-plan exits retain existing signed write fencing.
GuardedOpeningSubmit and ManagementSignedRequest both deny OPEN; settings writes are also forbidden. Request parameters are copied before classification and guarded waits.

Recovery/protection/exits run under the existing exclusive pipeline lock; no full DataRuntime.tick. Per-stage route checks are released before stage execution; every signed mutation still reacquires the real route and reduction guards.

Ordinary stage failure does not skip later protection/exit attempts. Ownership failure stops remaining stages; stop requests are observed between phases. No stage runs until STARTED checkpoint commits.

Two bounded heartbeat summaries per cycle reuse controlled diagnostic retention. Current-head/history identity, exact binding, ordered phase completion and start-based age are required for health. Diagnostic health never grants execution authority.
Only CLEAR sends successful progress. Responsive DEGRADED keeps the management worker but not healthy status; lack of completed-cycle contact triggers new-mode-only timeout recovery.

Controller preserves retained worker handle after failed stop, including when a newer desired epoch arrives. Confirmed stop precedes same-source DRAINING recovery with a fresh token; direct start refuses to overwrite an existing worker handle.

qa.boundary: One disposable PostgreSQL/Redis harness over Unix sockets at a time; V2 conftest blocks external TCP. No running trading database, exchange API or real supervised account process.
qa.scope: 54 selected orchestration/controller/management/protection/exit/settlement and legacy-compatibility regression files; not the entire repository or real exchange acceptance.

intermediate_runs.note: Corruption fixture UPDATE was rejected by the existing state-version trigger. Changed only fixture to transaction-scoped trigger disable/corrupt/re-enable in disposable QA schema, retaining original fail-closed health assertion.
Focused integrated PG regression after fixture/config/controller fixes. Overlaps final regression; not additive.

offline_review_tests.scope: Real ChildWorker lifecycle and ExecutionController methods, in-memory route persistence and fake OS process/IPC; no actual process fault-injection claim.

independent_review: Ownership/composition and runtime acceptance reviewed independently. Final review found no remaining P1/P2 in the frozen increment. Resolved false success, stop propagation, irrelevant-config startup coupling and retained-worker replacement findings.

read_only_service_observation.scope: Service metadata only; no fresh exchange-position claim.

remaining_before_activation: New independent typed entry and bounded settlement processes, with explicit ownership/close order; new mode is currently an alternative to legacy orchestration, not concurrent with it.
Shared testnet-protocol-account lock can still make management BUSY if external settlement owns it. This increment does not prove progress through arbitrary settlement lock hangs.

Signed requests have socket timeouts, not an overall wall-clock deadline. Database route lock waits are bounded (5 seconds), but the guard transaction has no idle timeout. Failed revocation raises and leaves the token unchanged; supervisor finally attempts DRAINING and stops the child before exiting. Recovery may require service restart rather than completing in-loop. No second worker is spawned by a failed revocation.
Legacy optional quant exits require ClickHouse and are not constructed in management-only mode. Basic/emergency/native and frozen-plan handling do not imply full legacy optional-exit parity.

Wire outer controller alerts/dashboard to management-latest and move optional notification work outside the recovery-supervision path. Existing outer monitor still uses legacy daemon/business probes; new diagnostic health is implemented/tested but not yet projected there.

New causal opportunity worker, terminal signal decisions and real frozen-plan OPEN authorization/readiness/baseline wiring, followed by complete simulated OPEN-to-settlement faults and actual deployment/restart/load acceptance.
Typed outcome dashboard/research projections and P2 strategy comparison/out-of-sample evidence. Engineering QA does not establish profitability.
profitability_claim: None. Entries remain paused; frozen risk-trail/v1 is an explicit engineering contract, not a validated profitable strategy.
